entities.name: Coliseum Island
entities.description: Island in the swamps outside Aphetto, once the site of the Grand Coliseum.

entities.name: Grand Coliseum
entities.description: Giant arena built by the Cabal on Coliseum Island and destroyed by Karona.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: Annihilated the Grand Coliseum in a rage and left Dominaria.

entities.name: Cabal City
entities.description: City destroyed during the Battle for the Mirari.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: Battle in which Cabal City was destroyed.

entities.name: Cabal Patriarch
entities.description: Ordered construction of the Grand Coliseum.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: Overseer of the coliseum's construction who wiped out the island's villagers.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: Sought by Karona; escaped through a portal.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Escaped through a portal to Aphetto.

entities.name: Lowallyn
entities.description: Escaped through a portal to Aphetto.

events.summary: Phage offers the villagers on Coliseum Island an ultimatum, then wipes them out and levels the village.
events.quote: she promptly wiped them all out and leveled their village utterly

events.summary: Karona drains the area of mana looking for Kuberr.
events.quote: she drained the area of mana

events.summary: Kuberr, Kamahl and Lowallyn escape through a portal and Karona annihilates the coliseum in a rage.
events.quote: Karona proceeded to annihilate the rest of the coliseum in a rage

events.summary: When Karona leaves Dominaria, the island sinks back into the swamp.
events.quote: the island sank back into the muck to be reclaimed fully by the swamp

relations.note: Oversaw the construction of his arena.
relations.quote: The building efforts were overseen by Phage
Karona proceeded to annihilate the rest of the coliseum in a rage
